title: Why Teleportation Would Kill You
summary: CGP Grey asks whether Star Trek-style teleportation would kill you and recreate a copy, working through the philosophy of identity and the Ship of Theseus. It is a short animated explainer.
why: Pointed to in threads about mind uploading and teleportation as a good, accessible look at personal identity.

quote.text: CGP Grey has a good look at the question wrt Star Trek teleportation
